description: Opioid Crisis Having witnessed the tragedy of Opioid addiction in his own extended family, Rep. Setzler in his role as Subcommittee Chairman, coordinated the passage of Senate Bill 36, the state’s first ever Prescription Drug Monitoring Program database. This PDMP database allows doctors and pharmacists to centrally track prescriptions of opioids and other addictive drugs ... Read more
